page.overview:
Who is Lyrica Lilac?

Lyrica Lilac, or simply Lyrica, is a female Earth pony with a pale lavender coat, a light yellow mane, purple eyes, and a lyre cutie mark. The parts of her name were given by fans before they were adopted officially by Hasbro. She has speaking roles in Green Isn't Your Color and The Best Night Ever.__TOC__

Lyrica Lilac shares her design with Purple Wave, "Majesty", "Pampered Pearl", and "Reflective Rock".

Lyrica Lilac was to appear in Call of the Cutie.

Lyrica Lilac appears mostly as a background pony in the show, usually alongside fellow frequently appearing high society ponies Count Caesar, Sealed Scroll, and Royal Ribbon.
